Part Number: SA750C-8GOC


                                                      SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ A750 ORC OC Edition, 8GB GDDR6, ThermalSync™, TORN
                                                      Cooling, Axial Fan, Metal Backplate, SA750C-8GOC

                                                      The SPARKLE Intel Arc A750 ORC OC Edition provides high performance and myriad of productivity
                                                      without any thing getting in the way.
                                                      ORC Series equipped TORN Cooling with double customized AXL fans, 2.2 slot design and full metal
                                                      backplate for compatibility with all types of gaming case. TITAN series also has patented(pending)
                                                      ThermalSync™, which allow users monitor their GPU temperature at all times.
